source: Smogon ADV OU Sample Teams Official Thread
description: Official curated sample teams representing ADV OU's major archetypes, organized by playstyle

spikes_balance.description: The quintessential ADV playstyle combining Spikes, Sand Stream Tyranitar, and Toxic to slowly wear down opponents while maintaining defensive stability

teams.name: Big 5 + Starmie (Beerlover)
teams.author: UD
teams.description: The quintessential TSS style. Features bulky physical Tyranitar (BKCTar) breaking cores with Spikes support. Gengar spinblocks offensively with Will-O-Wisp and Explosion. Swampert provides defensive backbone in sand. Offensive Starmie variant (Beerlover) provides speed control and Spikes management.
teams.2024_trends: Thunderbolt + Ice Punch Gengar, defensive Starmie

teams.name: Forretress Gengar Dug
teams.author: M Dragon
teams.description: Standard balance with Dugtrio. Arena Trap revenge-kills Celebi, Jirachi, and Tyranitar. Forretress provides Spikes + Rapid Spin role compression. Pursuit Tyranitar eliminates ghosts and Rapid Spin users. Gengar spinblocks while checking Flygon, Salamence, and Suicune.

teams.name: Gengar + Jirachi Superman TSS
teams.author: ADV Community
teams.description: One of the oldest ADV styles. Based on trading Spikes while hovering most team members above them (Flygon, Zapdos, Gengar). Jirachi provides Wish support and physical checking. Tyranitar with Pursuit stops Gengar and fire birds. Rest Zapdos checks special attackers with Roar anti-setup.

teams.name: Moltres Superman TSS
teams.author: Golden Sun
teams.description: Offensive Superman variant. Moltres over Zapdos makes it stronger vs offense but lacks secondary special wall, placing more pressure on Jirachi. Jirachi Fire Punch + Gengar's coverage wears down Skarmory. Destiny Bond removes Rapid Spin users and last-mon threats.
teams.recommended_changes: Toxic Jirachi, DBond Gengar, Flamethrower Moltres

teams.name: SkarmMag + Aerodactyl TSS
teams.author: ABR, updated by Astamatitos
teams.description: Combines Spikes with Magneton trapping Skarmory. Double down on defensive sets that don't touch Skarmory well. Curse Rest Swampert breaks defensive teams. Aero provides speed control and fast cleaning. Be aware mixed attackers and Gengar can be difficult.

teams.name: MixMence Claydol TSS
teams.author: ADV Community
teams.description: Classic mixed Salamence Spikes team. Tyranitar and Metagross break for Salamence. Blissey absorbs special attacks while retaliating. Claydol handles opposing Spikes in this Skarmory beatdown style. Salamence Intimidate + Metagross + Claydol checks opposing Tyranitar.

teams.name: Zapdos MixMence Forre TSS
teams.author: ADV Community
teams.description: Forretress provides Spikes+Spin role compression and limits opposing Skarmory Spikes. Pursuit Tyranitar fights spinblockers and punishes fliers. Swampert is defensive backbone. Aromatherapy Blissey provides speed control and status healing. Rest Zapdos dishes powerful hits with Roar anti-setup. Mixed Salamence with Wish helps pivots.

spikes_offense.description: Fast-paced offensive teams using Spikes to pressure opponents and break through defenses quickly

teams.name: Special Wall-less TSS (El Clásico)
teams.author: Hclat
teams.description: Similar to AeroBi, doubles down on Rock-types to overwhelm defenses with Spikes. Gengar and defensive Refresh Swampert allow slower play vs balance. No Electric resist means careful pivoting is required to deal with Electric attacks.

teams.name: Jolteon Starmie Spikes Stack
teams.author: Kerts
teams.description: Fast early game Zapdos answer generating momentum. Gengar spinblocks offensively. Starmie punishes Ground-types and provides offensive pressure. Tyranitar and Metagross punish Blissey/Snorlax and break defenses. Claydol can cause trouble - keep Skarmory healthy for spin denial.
teams.2024_trends: Thunder Wave Tyranitar for DDMence, Agility Metagross

teams.name: Zapdos + AeroBi Spikes Offense
teams.author: Shitrock enjoyer
teams.description: AeroBi overwhelms defenses with shared offensive profiles. DD Tyranitar lures physical walls, opening holes for Aerodactyl. Prioritize Spikes early. Celebi and Zapdos check Waters while dishing powerful moves under sand and Spikes. Swampert is defensive check with invested Hydro Pump.

teams.name: DDTar + Starmie Spikes Offense
teams.author: Shitrock enjoyer
teams.description: More offensive take on Spikes + MixMence. Generate early momentum with Spikes and offensive Celebi pressuring switches. Tyranitar breaks physically defensive pieces for Agility Metagross endgame. Offensive Starmie provides speed control and Spikes management. Focus on positive trades for endgame win condition.

teams.name: Regice Spikes Offense
teams.author: Jirachee
teams.description: Regice is best lead Skarmory partner. Generates offensive momentum vs lead Zapdos. Thunder Waving Tyranitar/Metagross or threatening Skarmory with super effective moves is crucial. Exploding into special checks helps Suicune and Gengar. Gengar oppresses with coverage and Explosion. Sleep Talk Suicune is midgame breaker. Agility Metagross provides physical checking and late-game cleaning. Claydol provides Rapid Spin and explodes on slow setup mons.

teams.name: Charizard Spikes Offense
teams.author: Shitrock enjoyer
teams.description: Unexplored but effective. Charizard with Spikes uses chip damage to achieve KO ranges it normally wouldn't. DD Tyranitar works as main breaker, baiting and trading with Waters. Fire Blast Flygon lures and kills Skarmory before too many Spikes. Calm Mind Jirachi breaks defensive structures. Zapdos checks threats with Thunder Wave. Charizard helps vs Jirachi/Celebi weakness.

stall.description: Extremely defensive teams focused on wearing down opponents through passive damage and outlasting them

teams.name: Tyranitar + MiloDol TSS
teams.author: Zokuru
teams.description: Blissey and Milotic feel impossible to eliminate together but are passive. Skarmory Spikes + Tyranitar sand provide passive damage. Tyranitar's physical power pressures walls and wallbreakers. Wear down CM Jirachi, Heracross, DD Salamence through Sand, Spikes, Toxic, or eliminate with Dugtrio. Claydol removes opposing Spikes.
teams.2024_trends: Other Pokemon that pressure Curselax > Tyranitar, like Suicune, Metagross

teams.name: Zapdos + CuneDol
teams.author: ADV Community
teams.description: Timeless stall team. Rest Zapdos + Thunder Wave Blissey handle most special attackers outside CM Blissey/Celebi/Jirachi. Suicune's longevity manages Tyranitar, Metagross, Swampert and serves as win condition with Calm Mind + Roar. Extremely dependent on Spikes and removing hazards with Claydol. Skarmory must spike multiple times vs spinners. Aerodactyl is threatening late game.

teams.name: Triple Natural Cure
teams.author: ABR
teams.description: Defensive take on MixMence Spikes. Defensive Starmie provides Spikes control and paralysis spreading for Salamence breaking. Defensive Celebi scares setup threats like Snorlax/Suicune while sponging Waters. Metagross is physically defensive answer with Salamence Intimidate support but can break vs slower teams. Wish Blissey helps longevity.

teams.name: Suicune + MiloDol (Vir5in)
teams.author: Kerts
teams.description: One of the most popular defensive Dugtrio structures (Virgin 5). Specializes in winning Spikes game with Skarmory as reliable spiker and Claydol as spinner. Solid defensive backbone minimizes health loss on Skarmory. Blissey and Milotic sponge special/physical attacks. Suicune complements defense while phazing and breaking endgame. Dugtrio eliminates offensive cores and wallbreakers. Spikes chip is important to make Dugtrio OHKO targets.

teams.name: Curse RestLax ForreDol
teams.author: ABR
teams.description: One of the most divisive teams in ADV history. Rest Suicune + Blissey + Rest Snorlax keep most of metagame in check. Forretress + Spikes make it extremely difficult to break past multiple extremely bulky Pokemon. Common wallbreakers (CM Jirachi, DD Tar, Raikou) trapped by Dugtrio. Claydol removes threats via Explosion and clears Spikes. Thunder Wave Blissey + Sunny Day Claydol (removes sand for Leftovers) make progress extremely difficult.

hyper_offense.description: Extremely aggressive teams with suicide leads and multiple setup sweepers

teams.name: Smeargle Offense
teams.author: ADV Community
teams.description: Fast paced offensive teams relying on suicide lead with sleep support. Smeargle can Spikes or Spore on most common leads. DD Tyranitar breaks physical defenses for late game Liechi Aerodactyl. Endeavor Swampert checks physical attacks while threatening with Roar + Endeavor + Spikes. Mixed Metagross is early Skarmory beater and wallbreaker. Gengar spinblocks and explodes to turn momentum. Sinking momentum and free spinning are scariest for Smeargle teams.

trappers_spikeless_offense.description: Offensive teams using Magneton/Dugtrio trapping without relying on Spikes

teams.name: Blue Offense
teams.author: Noitu
teams.description: Iconic Magneton offense with signature blue color palette. Lead Suicune threatens Tyranitar and forces favorable sequences. Flexible as bulky Water and setup breaker/sweeper. Snorlax is main special check, forcing switches and threatening Explosion. Banded Metagross is powerful breaker and one-time physical check. Mixed Salamence is anti-offense. Heracross with Magneton weather clearing works as Sub-Salac + Swords Dance + Swarm cleaner.

teams.name: Medicham Cune Offense
teams.author: Mana
teams.description: Medicham is one of the most threatening leads, scaring Tyranitar and creating advantageous positions. Takes advantage of early chip damage. Salamence and Suicune enjoy dealing with chipped Flying-types. Magneton traps chipped Metagross. Lum Berry Medicham counters Gengar. Snorlax is main special check and progress-maker. Calm Suicune (ManaCune) wins vs CM Blissey and helps vs Zapdos. Agility Metagross checks physically and closes games.

teams.name: Aero SD Pass
teams.author: z0mOG
teams.description: Classic archetype. Swords Dance Baton Pass Celebi supports strong sweepers, turning fast cleaners into breakers. Celebi needs lots of support. Pursuit Tyranitar deals with Gengar and Fire-types. Magneton eliminates Skarmory. Leech Seed helps Celebi vs other Roar Pokemon and gives longevity. Recover for short term. Swampert is main physical check. Metagross and Liechi Aerodactyl are breakers and sweepers.

teams.name: ZapDug
teams.author: ADV Community
teams.description: ZapDug abuses structures using Blissey as main Zapdos check early. Beat up bulky Dugtrio traps Blissey, living Ice Beam without Spikes chip. Baton Pass Zapdos enables this interaction. Mixed Metagross and Claydol are Skarmory bait + Spikes clearing combo and defensive backbone. Suicune breaks defensive cores and opens holes in offensive ones. CM + 3 attacks Celebi is late game cleaner.

teams.name: Jynx Special Offense
teams.author: Hclat
teams.description: Like ZapDug, relies on Dugtrio trapping Blissey to open space for special threats. Jynx instantly threatens with Lovely Kiss and Calm Mind. Glass-cannon playstyle. Suicune used early to overwhelm defenses, opening setup for Substitute Jirachi. Jirachi is strong cleaner heavily abusing passive sets. Claydol is defensive check removing Spikes. Gengar is Normal-type switch-in generating offensive momentum.

teams.name: Quad Band
teams.author: M Dragon
teams.description: Features 4 Choice Band users. Showcased overwhelming defenses concept. Banded Tyranitar and banded Metagross are early hard hitters, crippling walls into Dug range for Aero to clean endgame. Zapdos is main special defense check with Toxic and Rest. Swampert provides defensive sturdiness vs physical threats.

trappers_spikeless_balance.description: Balanced teams using Magneton to trap Steel-types without Spikes

teams.name: CB Mence MagDol
teams.author: BKC
teams.description: Specializes in reliably trapping Skarmory and spinning Spikes afterwards. With Spikes gone, grounded Pokemon exercise better defense and longevity. Magneton cripples other Steel-types like Metagross and Jirachi after Skarmory is gone. Sunny Day clears Sand for Suicune, Blissey, Salamence once Tyranitar faints. Banded Salamence is main progress maker. Metagross and Suicune provide breaking and physical resistance. Wish Blissey heals teammates.

trapless_spikeless_offense.description: Pure offensive teams relying on breaking power without trapping or Spikes

teams.name: Charizard Houdini CMPass
teams.author: SEA
teams.description: Calm Mind Baton Pass breaks through special checks. Metagross lures Skarmory with Banded Explosion (Houdini - makes Skarmory 'disappear'). Celebi takes advantage of free turns to Calm Mind and pass. Zapdos keeps baton pass chain while boosted. DD Hidden Power Grass Tyranitar deals with Swampert and breaks defenses. Substitute Swampert is defensive piece and Blissey breaker. Charizard threatens opposing Calm Minders and dishes powerful Fire moves when boosted.

teams.name: CBMeta CroCune Skarm Beatdown
teams.author: ADV Community
teams.description: Classic spikesless archetype using many Pokemon that lure and heavily chip Skarmory. Typically has spin support to clear acquired Spikes. Banded Metagross is consistent Skarmory beater and early breaker while being defensive with Salamence Intimidate. Snorlax punishes special attackers similarly. Pursuit Tyranitar eliminates Gengar and checks fliers. Suicune is important breaker. Salamence takes advantage of simplified positions for endgame cleaning.

teams.name: MixZap Houdini DDTar MixOff
teams.author: ADV Community
teams.description: Similar to Charizard CM Pass but different breakers. Mixed Zapdos is interesting Celebi punisher while forcing damage and checking Starmie. Swampert is defensive force with offensive capabilities. Tyranitar provides offensive breaking with defensive capabilities. Jirachi is powerful breaker with enough bulk to Calm Mind vs multiple special attackers. Salamence impacts late game with Dragon Dance.

teams.name: WishJira Skarm Beatdown
teams.author: Astamatitos
teams.description: More defensive Skarmory beatdown. Wish Jirachi helps longevity while threatening Skarmory long-term. Mixed Salamence is fast threat to offense. Snorlax and Jirachi lure Skarmory to chip it early, limiting Spikes stacking. Claydol cleans residual Spikes and threatens Explosion. Pursuit Tyranitar alleviates ghost weakness and checks Flying-types. Suicune breaks walls midgame and cleans endgames.

teams.name: Raikou Celebi Slop
teams.author: Shitrock enjoyer (Fruhdazi creation)
teams.description: Most recent Hyper Offense addition (commonly known as 'Slop'). Setup-sweeper-driven structure focusing on opening winning paths by forcing trades. DD Tyranitar and Endeavor Swampert are fundamental - Tyranitar should DD turn one vs everything except Metagross, then attack turn two. Goal is weakening checks/counters for partners. Registeel is team sponge, spreading paralysis/toxic and exploding for momentum. CM Celebi, CM Raikou, or DD Salamence serves as cleaner depending on game state. Main objective: overwhelm defensive core.

trapless_spikeless_balance.description: Balanced teams without trapping or Spikes, relying on defensive cores and breaking power

teams.name: Yama BandMence
teams.author: ADV Community
teams.description: Hariyama is unique fighter with Knock Off access. Removing items forces progress easily even without Spikes, punishing Blissey and Skarmory. Choice Band Salamence complements Yama, providing better offense matchup with Intimidate and coverage. Takes advantage of Knock Off to break itemless defensive threats. Suicune and Jirachi offer defensive profile with Wish support. Both can break walls long term. Aromatherapy Blissey covers lack of status immunities. Claydol cleans Spikes and forces damage.
